name: fojlerabbirabib/apiclient-drive-service
description: A slim, auto-synced, Drive-only subset of google/apiclient-services (unofficial, not affiliated with Google).

suggest.google/apiclient: ^2.15 — provides Google\Client, Google\Service, Google\Service\Resource, Google\Model, Google\Collection. NOT a hard require here because google/apiclient's own composer.json hard-requires google/apiclient-services (~0.350), which this package conflicts with — installing both together is unresolvable by design (see NOTICE / README). Either wire up google/apiclient's official Google\Task\Composer::cleanup post-install script with an empty keep-list yourself, or bring a different Google\Client-compatible base.
